485.description:
This willow fishing rod is broken
and unusable.

494.name: Quadav Augury Shell
494.description:
Quadavs use this land crab shell
for divination.

495.name: Quadav Charm
495.description: A Quadav charm made of darksteel.

497.name: Gigas Socks
497.description:
A pair of socks worn by the Gigas.
They are too large for people to wear.

498.name: Yagudo Bead Necklace
498.description:
A bead necklace worn by the Yagudo.
It is too large for people to wear.

499.name: Gigas Necklace
499.description:
A pearl necklace worn by the Gigas.
It is too large for people to wear.

501.name: Quadav Helm
501.description:
A helmet worn by the Quadav.
It is far too bulky for people to wear.

506.name: Square Of Coeurl Leather
506.description:
This cured coeurl leather is light,
yet durable.

507.name: Goblin Mail
507.description:
Bronze armor worn by Goblin warriors.
Due to its odd shape, only Goblins
can wear it.

508.name: Goblin Helm
508.description:
A bronze helm worn by Goblin warriors.
Due to its odd shape, only Goblins
can wear it.

510.name: Goblin Armor
510.description:
Armor made of cloth and leather.
Due to its odd shape, only Goblins
can wear it.

511.name: Goblin Mask
511.description:
A mask that filters out bad odors.
Due to its odd shape, only Goblins
can wear it.

529.name: Luminicloth
529.description:
This cloth is woven from
an astral fabric that glows faintly.
It is too frail to be used for tailoring.

530.name: Copy Of The Castle Floor Plans
530.description:
A copy of the floor plans used in the
construction of Chateau d'Oraguille.

531.name: Lanolin Cube
531.description:
The Goblins make these cubes out of
fat harvested from sheep wool.
It is a main ingredient in Goblin soap.

533.name: Chunk Of Derfland Humus
533.description:
This humus is only found in Derfland.
Its richness is said to come from
crawler droppings in the mix.

534.name: Clump Of Gausebit Wildgrass
534.description:
This grass is similar to gysahl greens.
Gausebit wildgrass has medicinal
properties for chocobos, but doesn't
taste very good.

535.name: Engraved Key
535.description:
This brass key is engraved with the
San d'Orian royal family's insignia.

537.name: Damselfly Worm
537.description:
A parasitic worm that lives in
the stomachs of damselflies.

538.name: Magicked Skull
538.description:
This skull is inhabited by
the cursed soul of its former owner.

539.name: Crab Apron
539.description:
The soft abdominal shell of
a land crab.

540.name: Bloody Robe
540.description:
Ragged and bloodied robes that
belonged to a ghost.

541.name: Cup Of Dhalmel Saliva
541.description:
A cup of dhalmel saliva,
known for its phenomenal stench.

542.name: Wild Rabbit Tail
542.description:
Wild rabbit tails are believed to bring
good luck.

543.name: Rusty Key
543.description:
This rusty iron key looks
extremely brittle.

544.name: Pile Of Answer Sheets
544.description:
These terribly blotched and smeared 
sheets of paper are answer sheets 
from a test given at Windurst's 
School of Magic.

549.name: Delkfutt Key
549.description:
This cermet key has an unusually
complex shape.

550.name: Steam Clock
550.description:
This precise Bastokan timekeeper runs
on steam power.

551.name: Bruised Starfruit
551.description:
A star tree fruit used in
the construction of a Cardian.
It looks damaged.

554.name: Gold Orcmask
554.description:
A golden mask worn by Orcish royalty.
Due to its odd shape, only Orcs can
wear it.

557.name: Ahriman Lens
557.description:
A giant crystal lens taken from
an Ahriman.

560.name: Pinch Of Zeruhn Soot
560.description:
Soot taken from monsters in the
Zeruhn mines. It is highly flammable
and should be handled with care.

563.name: Chunk Of Glocolite
563.description:
This bumpy, precious stone shines
dimly.

572.description: Seeds for some kind of herb.

This bronze box sat on the ocean floor
for many years.

582.description:
This black stone is said to have fallen
from the sky.

583.name: Smooth Stone
583.description:
This round stone is the perfect size
to use as a weight for making pickles.

584.name: Torn Epistle
584.description:
This torn envelope appears to contain
a love letter addressed to a man.

585.name: Muddy Bar Tab
585.description:
This paper appears to be a list of
items consumed at a tavern.
Smeared mud conceals part of the list.

586.name: Odd Postcard
586.description:
A card sent to celebrate something.
It shows a great deal of wear and tear.

587.name: Damp Envelope
587.description:
An envelope sealed with wax.
It is damp and somewhat warped.

596.name: Quadav Backplate
596.description:
A darksteel shell worn by the Quadav.
It is far too heavy for people to wear.

605.name: Pickaxe
605.description:
These pickaxes are used by
mine laborers to excavate passages.

This appears to be the head of

a brass fetich used in Quadav magic.

a brass fetich used in Quadav magic.

These appear to be the legs of
a brass fetich used in Quadav magic.

A kind of seaweed found near
the Pamtam Straits.

metal.

as a material for grass thread.

Harvested from common Sarutabaruta
cotton, these seeds contain
a fiber used in cotton thread.

complicated process. It is a traditional
cloth woven in a land far to the south.

A piece of a spider's web.

A piece of a crawler's cocoon.
Used for making silk thread.

the legendary phoenix.

The lustrously patterned hide 
of a coeurl.

The wave-like ridges of these
scales are unlike those found
on any other beast.

The light and brightly colored scales 
of a wyvern.

867.description: The giant scales of a dragon.

868.name: Handful Of Pugil Scales
868.description: The hard and durable scales of a pugil.

The fleece of a mythical ram. Its
magnificent luster is legendary.

A slippery, slimy
strip of skin from a manta.

This demon skull contains
traces of metal.

The thick cephalic exoskeleton of
a beetle.

A rock-hard femur from
some giant beast.

The light but sturdy carapace of
a scorpion.

This claw was taken from a scorpion
known for its potent venom.

This Demon horn is mostly metallic
in composition.

This dragon talon is large,
yet razor-sharp.

This wyvern skull is lighter than
it looks.

The head part of
a starmite's exoskeleton.

This bone is chillingly cold
to the touch.

A fragment of the remarkably hard
shell of the Adamantoise. Its
impenetrability closely resembles that
of the precious metal, adaman.

Compared to most wyvern skulls, this
one is relatively sturdy.

A horn belonging to a giant sheep
known as Lumbering Lambert.

911.name: Rampaging Horn
911.description:
A horn belonging to a giant sheep
known as Rampaging Ram.

Part of a beehive formed by
hardened bee secretions.

A sharp needle from
the head of a cactuar.

This rare, parasitic plant
can be found on large trees.

919.name: Clump Of Boyahda Moss

This moss grows on
the back of the goobbue.

A vine cut from a malboro.

twitches occasionally.

This blood appears to have
come from a monstrous fiend.

A hollow needle taken from
a giant wasp.

A tail cut from a lizard.
Still partly alive, the tail
twitches occasionally.

Said to be able to sense movement
at great distances.

930.name: Vial Of Beastman Blood
930.description:
This blood appears to
have come from a beastman.

A sulfurous powder found near
the caldera of Mount Yuhtunga.

A large wing cut off an Ahriman.
Still partly alive, the wing
twitches occasionally.

A chunk of rock salt
that can be found on land.

the skin and bones of animals.

A grass favored by the dhalmel.
It is easily recognized by its small, 
yellow flowers.

A living eyeball, cut from a hecteyes.
It can still see, and if left alone,
will begin dividing.

A root clipping from the legendary
revival tree. Burning it creates smoke
that can bring the dead back to life.

for these stones. Invaluable as
an ingredient in high level alchemy.

943.name: Pinch Of Poison Dust
943.description:
This dust is an ingredient
in poison potions.

947.name: Jar Of Firesand

1631.name: Moblin Armor
1631.description:

can wear it.

1632.description:
Simple brass armor. Due to its odd
shape, only Moblins can wear it.

1633.name: Handful Of Clot Plasma
1633.description:
A miniature plasmoid sample taken from
a clot species of the slime family. It
is perfectly edible, and quite delicious,
once detoxified.

1638.description:
A leather mask that filters out dust
and smoke. Due to its odd shape, only
Moblins can wear it.

1639.description:

clothing, preventing anything living
from wearing it.

1640.description: The bumpy skin of a bugard.

1649.description:

1651.name: Spool Of Moblin Thread
1651.description:

1653.description:
This magical pen is made from the

a piece of parchment, it will
write one's diary for him.

1654.name: Igneous Rock
1654.description: This rock is formed when magma cools.

1658.description:
A sealion is engraved into the handle

1659.description:

handle of this brass key.

1660.description: A simple key forged from bronze.

1662.description:

been recognized by the San d'Orian
Cathedral as an authentic relic.

1663.name: Arnica Root
1663.description:
When ground into a powder and
served with hot water, the
root of the arnica has the
ability to cure various ailments.

1664.name: Eastern Gem
1664.description:
These flat, round jade stones are
treasured in lands to the Far East.

1665.name: Copper Key
1665.description: A tiny key made of pure copper.

1666.description:
This rare diamond changes color

1667.name: Cluster Core
1667.description: The molten center of a cluster.

1668.description:

1669.name: Pinch Of Hoary Bomb Ash
1669.description: The burnt remains of an ancient bomb.

1680.name: High-Quality Bugard Skin
1680.description:
This bugard skin is in excellent

1682.description:
The Kingdom of San d'Oria stores
these ingots in the heavily guarded
royal treasury. The mark of the griffon
is imbedded in the center of each bar.

1683.name: Piece Of Attohwa Ginseng
1683.description:
This medicinal root only grows in
the arid soil of the Attohwa
Chasm. Its rarity makes it quite
expensive.

1684.name: Gold Key
1684.description: An elaborately designed solid gold key.

1685.name: Bottle Of Warding Oil
1685.description:
Members of the Quadav patrol use this
pungent oil in their lamps. It is said
that the strong odor the oil emits

1691.description:

1695.description:

1696.description:

1698.name: Extra-Fine File
1698.description:
It is said Demons use these files to

1700.description:
This scarlet thread is produced by a
variety of diremite. Much like a
spider's web, it is extremely light,
but unbelievably strong.

1703.description:
This ore contains traces of the metal

1704.name: Kunwu Iron
1704.description:
A chunk of kunwu iron, smelted using
a traditional Far Eastern method.

1706.name: Nyumomo Doll
1706.description:
The main character from the
ridiculously popular "Nyumomo, the
Twirling Taru" comics. There is not
a girl in Jeuno who has not begged
her father to buy her one of these
dolls.

1707.name: Piece Of Eastern Paper
1707.description:
This high-quality paper has been made
with advanced methods known only
to those living in the Eastern empire.

1708.name: Handful of Counterfeit Gil
1708.description:
It is rumored the Goblins make these
replicas of real gil. However, because
they cannot duplicate the magic
imprint cast by the Vana'diel Treasury,
most shopkeeps can easily spot one.

1709.name: Naphille Pochette
1709.description:
Naphille is known around Jeuno for
being on the cutting edge of fashion
trends. Anyone who's who in the duchy
can be seen carrying one of her
outrageously expensive pochettes.

1710.name: Copy Of Fernans Diaries
1710.description:
This biography portrays a day in the
life of Jeuno's most popular actor,
Fernan. From witty quotes to
true-to-life drawings, there is enough
material in this book to make any fan
drool.

1712.description:
This lustrous wool is found on a

Eastern nations.

1714.description:

the more common wools.

1718.name: Megalobugard Tusk
1718.description: The twisted tusk of a megalobugard.

1719.name: Harajnite Shell
1719.description:

1726.description:

1980.description:

1981.name: Skull Locust
1981.description:
This variety of locust has been
devastating Sarutabaruta in recent
years. It is said that mages affixed
the eerie mark resembling a skull to
its head as a prank.

1982.name: King Locust
1982.description:
This variety of locust inhabits the
Giddeus area. The sound of its wings
on takeoff resembles a laughing voice.

1983.name: Mushroom Locust
1983.description:
This variety of locust has adapted
to the jungles of Elshimo. Its unusual

1984.name: Snapping Mole
1984.description:
A diminutive variety of mole
that inhabits the Gustaberg region,
snapping moles are very aggressive
and are known to bite miners' ankles.

1985.name: Helmet Mole
1985.description:
An unusual variety of mole that
inhabits Korroloka Tunnel, helmet
moles get their name from the hard
shell that covers their heads.

2123.description: The stiff hide of a catoblepas.

2146.description:
A pliable, beautiful scale from

2148.description:

2149.description: A feather from the wing of an apkallu.

2150.name: Colibri Feather
2150.description: A feather from the tail of a colibri.

2151.name: Marid Hide
2151.description: The stiff hide of a marid.

2153.name: Qiqirn Sandbag
2153.description:
The Qiqirn carry these sandbags for
a quick escape in times of emergency.
Only a Qiqirn can carry one.

2157.name: Imp Horn
2157.description:
Imps use these horns to call their
comrades. A spell cast on the horn
allows only its true master to use it.

2158.name: Hydra Fang
2158.description:
An extremely long and poisonous
hydra fang.

2159.name: Qutrub Bandage
2159.description:
One of the bandages that cover the
qutrubs' entire bodies. It is soaked
in embalming fluid and an assortment
of other unappetizing liquids.

2160.name: Troll Pauldron
2160.description:
A bronze shoulderpiece from the armor
of a Troll cannoneer. It is too heavy
for a person to equip.

2161.name: Troll Vambrace
2161.description:
A bronze armpiece from the armor of
a Troll hoplite. It is too heavy for
a person to equip.

2162.name: Mamool Ja Helmet
2162.description:
An iron helmet formerly worn by
a Mamool Ja fighter. Due to its odd
shape, only Mamool Ja can wear it.

2163.name: Imp Wing
2163.description:
This tiny wing continues to flap
desperately, even after being severed
from the imp's body.

2164.name: Pephredo Hive Chip
2164.description:
Part of a hive formed by hardened
pephredo secretions.

2165.name: Qutrub Gorget
2165.description:
This gorget once decorated the neck
of a Qutrub. It is too heavy for a
person to equip.

2166.name: Lock Of Marid Hair
2166.description: A long, stiff lock of marid hair.

2167.name: Lamian Armlet
2167.description:
This armlet once decorated a Lamia's
wrist. It would not fit on a person.

2168.name: Cerberus Claw
2168.description:
A claw from one of Cerberus's paws.
All who gaze upon it are filled with
a sense of dread.

2169.name: Cerberus Hide
2169.description:
The hide of the great beast Cerberus.
All who gaze upon it are filled with
a sense of dread.

2171.name: Colibri Beak
2171.description:
This crescent-shaped beak is so
hard that it is said to be able
to fracture the skull of any who
dare approach the colibri's nest.

2172.name: Hydra Scale
2172.description:
An extremely thick and flexible
hydra scale.

2173.name: Wamoura Cocoon
2173.description:
A cocoon made by a wamoura larva.
Used as an ingredient for making
wamoura silk.

2174.name: Archaic Mirror
2174.description:
A magical, ancient mirror excavated
by the beastmen.

2175.name: Chunk Of Flan Meat
2175.description:
A foul-smelling, gelatinous chunk
of meat from a variety of flan.

2188.name: Wyvern Tailskin
2188.description: This skin from the tail of a wyvern is remarkably pliant and durable.

2198.name: Water Spiders Web
2198.description: The glistening web of a rare breed of aquatic spider. A raw material used in making sparkstrand thread.

2218.name: Lamian Claw Key
2218.description:
This key has supposedly been
carved out of a claw by a Lamia.

2219.name: Lamian Fang Key
2219.description:

2220.name: Lamian Bone Key
2220.description:

2223.description:

2224.description:

2226.name: Mamook Blackscale Key
2226.description:

2227.name: Mamool Ja Collar
2227.description:
A luxurious standing collar once worn
by a Mamool Ja mage. Due to its odd
shape, only a Mamool Ja can wear it.

2229.name: Vial Of Chimera Blood
2229.description:
This blood appears to have
come from a chimera.
It glows faintly in the dark.

2335.name: Soulflayer Tentacle
2335.description:
A tentacle cut from the body of
a soulflayer. It still twitches
occasionally.

2336.name: Soulflayer Staff
2336.description:
A magical staff once carried by
a soulflayer. A malevolent curse has
been cast upon it so that only the
staff's owner can take hold of it.

2337.name: Clump Of Wamoura Hair
2337.description:
A clump of hair taken from the body
of a full-grown wamoura. An ingredient

2338.name: Wamoura Scale
2338.description:
A scale taken from the wing of
a full-grown wamoura. Its surface
sparkles with reflected light.

2355.name: Ja Jas Chestplate
2355.description:
The sturdy chestplate worn by

It is far too bulky for people to wear.

2356.name: Gurfurlurs Helmet
2356.description:

2357.name: Medusas Armlet
2357.description:
This armlet once decorated Medusa's
forearm. No one else can equip it.

2361.name: Ameretat Vine
2361.description:
A vine cut from an ameretat. Still
partly alive, the vine twitches
occasionally, searching for prey.

2365.name: Vial Of Demon Blood
2365.description:
This blood appears to have come
from a demon.

2371.name: Khimaira Horn
2371.description: The knotty horn of a mighty khimaira.

2372.name: Khimaira Mane
2372.description:
The thick, sinewy mane of a mighty
khimaira.

2373.name: Khimaira Tail
2373.description:
The severed tail of a khimaira. It still
moves as if it had a will of its own.

2375.name: Zhayolm Card
2375.description:

2376.name: Arrapago Card

2377.name: Bhaflau Card
2377.description:

2384.name: Smoke-Filled Flask
2384.description:
A cerulean gas swirls within this
stopped flask. A label on it reads
"Danger! Extremely Flammable."

2385.name: Moldy Buckler
2385.description:
A shield once worn by Gigas champion
Alkyoneus, originally taken from one
of his past victims. It has seen much
wear and cannot be equipped.

2386.name: Hoary Battle Horn
2386.description:
The horn of a colossal wyrm carved
into a battle horn by Gigas champion
Pallas. It is too large to sound.

2387.name: Flickering Lantern
2387.description:
A gilt lantern treasured by the fiend
Sozu Rogberry. The eerie flame burning
inside emits a surreal radiance.

2388.name: Chunk Of Diorite
2388.description:
Supposedly a piece broken from the
legendary beast Ullikummi. Flecks of
mica embedded in the stone sparkle
when held to the light.

2413.name: Coiler
2413.description:
A thunder-based automaton
attachment.

Functionality:
 ・Occasionally grants the automaton
 　bonus melee attacks

2414.name: Steam Jacket
2414.description:
A water-based automaton attachment.

Functionality:
 ・Reduces damage taken from
 　successive attacks of the same type

2426.name: Wivre Horn
2426.description: The massive horn of a wivre.

2427.name: Wivre Maul
2427.description:
The tip of a wivre tail. Often called a
"maul" due to its striking resemblance
to the popular melee weapon.

2428.name: Wivre Hide
2428.description:
The thick hide of a wivre. It is said
that not even the sharpest of blades
can penetrate this adamantine skin.

This prayer is necessary in purifying
a cursed helm.

2461.name: Rusty Medal
2461.description:
An old Republican Iron Medal.
The inscription on the back reads:
"863 C.E. Xarcabard."

2462.name: Frayed Arrow
2462.description:
A red string has been wrapped
around the shaft of this worn arrow.

2463.name: Tuft Of Colorful Hair
2463.description:
This tuft consists of hair
of several colors and textures.

2488.name: Piece Of Alexandrite
2488.description:
A rare and precious gem, the color of
which shifts between various hues of
green and red depending on the light.

2503.name: Handful Of Almonds
2503.description:
Seeds of the almond tree
found in the Near East.

2518.name: Smilodon Hide
2518.description: The striped hide of a smilodon.

2557.name: Scholars Testimony
2557.description:
This papyrus scroll reads:
"The bearer of this document has
 proven excellence in the ways of
 the scholar."

2570.name: Pelt Of Dawon
2570.description: The pelt of the legendary tigress Dawon, soft to the touch and beautifully patterned in fiery orange and black.

2609.name: Tinnins Fang
2609.description:
The lethally toxic fang of the hydra,
Tinnin. It continues to drip poison from
the venom ducts within.

2610.name: Armed Gears Fragment
2610.description:
A mechanical fragment taken from the
disassembled remains of the menacing
Armed Gears. It appears to be a
generator designed for providing large
quantities of power.

2611.name: Gotoh Zhas Necklace
2611.description:
Neckware of the Mamool Ja, Gotoh Zha
the Redolent. Forever imbued with the
indelible scent of its owner, it can be
equipped by none other.

2612.name: Deas Horn
2612.description:
Taken from the nasal protrusion of
the massive wivre Dea, this imposing
horn is perfectly adapted for impaling
unwary targets.

2613.name: Iriz Imas Hide
2613.description:
The thick, tough hide of Iriz Ima.
Its durability is a testament to its
capacity to protect the marid against
most forms of predation.

2614.name: Amooshahs Tendril
2614.description:
A wreathing, vinelike tendril amputated
from the malboro Lividroot Amooshah.
The meandering of the vine makes it
seem to continue to move, even in
death.

2615.name: Iriri Samariris Hat
2615.description:
The perfectly form-fit hat of Poroggo 
Iriri Samariri. Tailor-made to an
amphibious head, it cannot and will not
adorn the typical adventurer noggin.

2616.name: Vulpangues Wing
2616.description:
A wing clipping taken from the puk,
Vulpangue. Its lightness and thinness
belie both its strength and durability.

2617.name: Chamroshs Beak
2617.description:
The razor-sharp beak of the colibri
Chamrosh, capable of easily tearing
apart the flesh of most any creature.

2618.name: Gigiroons Cape
2618.description:
The cape and cowl of Qiqirn, Cheese
Hoarder Gigiroon. Fit to the unique
form of a Qiqirn body, it cannot be
donned by people, and reeks of
cheese.

2619.name: Sarameyas Hide
2619.description:
The tough, near-impenetrable hide of
Sarameya, one of the few known extant
members of the cerberus family.

2620.name: Nosferatus Claw
2620.description:
Plunged into its victims and then
licked clean of the dripping blood,
this clawed appendage of the vampyr
Nosferatu still possesses a tangible
eeriness.

2621.name: Bhurborlors Vambrace
2621.description:
The solid and well-worn plate
armguard once donned by the Troll,
Khromasoul Bhurborlor. As with all troll
armor, it is far too cumbersome to be
worn by even the strongest of people.

2622.name: Achamoths Antenna
2622.description:
An antenna taken from the fallen
wamoura, Achamoth. This tentacular
appendage is adept at detecting even
invisible and silent prey.

2623.name: Anantabogas Heart
2623.description:
The enormous heart of the dragon,
Anantaboga. It is still saturated
through and through with foul reptilian
blood.

2624.name: Pile Of Reactons Ashes
2624.description:
The smoldering remains of the bomb,
Reacton. Despite the passage of time,
the cinders retain their immense heat.

2625.name: Blob Of Dextroses Blubber
2625.description:
The blubberous flesh of the flan,
Dextrose. It jiggles incessantly, even
when at rest.

2626.name: Brass Borers Cocoon
2626.description:
A cutting taken from the elaborate
cocoon spun by the larval wamoura,
Brass Borer.

2627.name: Globule Of Claret
2627.description:
A tiny blob of gelatinous flesh hacked
from the body of the slime, Claret.

2628.name: Obs Arm
2628.description:
A technologically advanced automaton
arm, salvaged from the dismantled
remains of Ob.

2629.name: Tygers Tail
2629.description:
Cleaved from the ferocious khimaira,
Tyger, this once lethal tail is wielded
in both whipping and stabbing motions.

2630.name: Mahjlaefs Staff
2630.description:
Too great in power and size to be
wielded by people, this wicked staff of
the soulflayer Mahjlaef the Paintorn is
no doubt responsible for the deaths of
countless adventurers.

2631.name: Experimental Lamias Armband
2631.description:
Decorative and protective armware of
Experimental Lamia. It inexplicably
resists being equipped on the arm of
any other.

2632.name: Nuhns Esca
2632.description:
The bioluminescent, bulbous sac of
the oboron, Nuhn. The light is used to
attract unsuspecting prey in the dark
depths of cold waters.

2633.name: Wulgarus Head
2633.description:
The severed head of the acrolith,
Wulgaru. It was once animated by a
most malicious arcane presence.

2634.name: Zareekhls Neckpiece
2634.description:
Necklace formerly worn by the qutrub,
Zareehkl the Jubilant. It is not
suited to dress the neck of any other individual.

2635.name: Verdelets Wing
2635.description:
The detached, fleshy wing of the imp,
Verdelet. Either by some latent magic,
or simply remaining nerves, it twitches
periodically.

2636.name: Velioniss Bone
2636.description:
A shard of blackened bone taken from
the remains of the wicked skeleton,
Velionis.

2637.name: Lil Apkallus Egg
2637.description:
A shiny egg laid by Lil' Apkallu. The
pale green hue of the eggshell is an
unmistakable sign.

2638.name: Chigre
2638.description:
The complete and well-preserved
corpse of arguably the rarest member
of the chigoe family, Chigre.

2662.name: Mirage Keffiyeh -1
2662.description:
A mirage keffiyeh.
It is badly damaged
and can no longer be worn.

2663.name: Mirage Jubbah -1
2663.description:
A mirage jubbah.
It is badly damaged
and can no longer be worn.

2664.name: Mirage Bazubands -1
2664.description:
A pair of mirage bazubands.
They are badly damaged
and can no longer be worn.

2665.name: Mirage Shalwar -1
2665.description:
